summary: Frontend-only test of the Expo web build at 390x844. All 8 requested feature groups PASS and there were no page errors. (1) Home: the mastery/streak card is gone. The search input home-search-input has the placeholder 'Search'. 'seminoma' returns 5 hits (male notes, flashcard, mnemonic) and 'portal' returns 31. A nonsense term shows search-no-results. home-search-clear empties the field and restores the 14 cards. Tapping a result opens /topic/male. (2) There are 14 topic cards in chapter order with biliary 4th, then neck, male and msk last. The Minimize toggle shrinks each card from 189px to 82px (chapter, title and % only), and Expand restores it. (3) Mock exam: 14 chapter toggles. Summary is '25 questions from 526 available' by default. Clear all shows 'Pick at least one chapter', the start button is aria-disabled and tapping it does not navigate. neck+msk gives 52 available; with 10 selected the counter shows 1/10. After finishing, 'Mock exam 2/10' appears in Recent quizzes. 50 from all chapters gives 1/50. Image mode with neck+msk gives 2 available. (4) The liver topic quiz shows 1/20 and 14 of the 20 questions had the quiz-source-textbook tag. (5) Image quiz: liver has 9 questions and urinary 14. Each has quiz-question-image (urinary image loaded, naturalWidth 640) and 4 options. The correct answer is the caption and the explanation shows it. History shows 'The Liver · Image quiz 3/9'. The neck topic has no images, so it has no image quiz button. (6) Liver collapse-all cuts the scroll height from 9659 to 1841. A single section-collapse header expands and collapses its section, and Expand all restores the full height. (7) biliary/neck/male/msk have 11/22/34/23 notes, 4/4/5/4 mnemonics, 12/12/14/12 flashcards and quiz pools of 29/27/29/25. (8) Regression PASS: msk flashcards flip and mark known; the neck-s1 bookmark shows in Saved and survives a reload; section read updates topic % on the topic and Home screens; theme toggles light to dark. Data check (node): 389 textbook questions, all answer indexes valid, one has a duplicate option. Two logic issues were found in code review: mock best score and image-quiz captions.

ui_bugs.issue: Every mock exam is stored under the single key 'mock' (quiz/[id].tsx:35), and recordQuiz keeps best as a raw score (store/progress.ts:115). The results card shows 'Best: {best}/{total}' using the current total. So after a 50-question mock scoring 30, a later 10-question mock shows 'Best: 30/10'. Fix: store best as a percentage, or key the record by count/chapters.

ui_bugs.component: Image quiz captions for new chapters
ui_bugs.issue: Most media.ts captions for biliary/male/msk are only section titles, e.g. 'Anatomy and Physiology', 'Sonography of the Bile Ducts', 'Vascular Anatomy of the Male Pelvis', 'Cryptorchidism', 'Hydrocele'. They become image-quiz answers and also distractors for other chapters. Seen live: 'Sonography of the Bile Ducts' offered as a distractor in the liver image quiz. These are not diagnoses, so the questions are vague or trivially guessable. Reference: src/data/media.ts:166-196

Some slide images have the diagnosis printed on them. Example: ur_adpkd.jpg shows the label 'Autosomal dominant polycystic disease' while the correct option is 'ADPKD'. Consider cropping or excluding labeled slides from image questions.

vasculature textbook question n=21 has a duplicated option, 'Aortic rupture' twice ([Aortic rupture, Chronic aortic aneurysm, Aortic dissection, Aortic rupture]). This is a PDF parse error. Reference: src/data/bookQuestions.json

issues: Results are not ranked. 'thyroid' (34 hits) lists Overview, Pancreas and Urinary 'hyperparathyroidism' notes before the Neck chapter's thyroid notes. Title matches and Topic hits should come first.
Tapping a Note result opens the topic at the top instead of scrolling to or highlighting the matched section.
The kicker still reads 'Abdominal sonography', but the app now covers Neck, Male Pelvis and MSK/Breast.
Textbook questions have no real explanation, only 'Textbook review question N (Chapter X) — answer from the book's answer key.' Consider adding a short rationale.
The collapsed/expanded state of sections is not persisted and resets every time the topic is reopened. Optional.

action_items: Fix mock exam best score so it cannot exceed total: store best as a percentage or key mock records by count (quiz/[id].tsx:35, store/progress.ts:110-124).
Replace the generic section-title captions for biliary/male/msk images in media.ts with real finding or diagnosis captions, or exclude them from imageQuestions/allCaptions.
Fix the duplicate option in bookQuestions.json vasculature n=21.
Optional: rank search results (title/topic matches first), scroll to the matched section on tap, and update the 'Abdominal sonography' kicker.
critical_code_review_comments: quiz.ts imageQuestions draws distractors at random from all captions without filtering generic titles, so quality depends on caption quality.
Pre-existing TS errors in src/theme.ts:145-146 (StyleSheet.NamedStyles not exported in this RN version). They do not affect runtime.
No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 4 data/logic quality issues
